reask.finding: the household size counts the rows of silc24_p per household, and silc24_p holds only the persons aged 15 and above: 10,379 of the 25,925 households have more members in the register silc24_pr (every member, all ages) than rows in silc24_p. A household's size is the number of its members in the register silc24_pr

the per-capita value divides the household's disposable income hg110 by a household size that counts only the persons aged 15 and above (the rows of silc24_p); the divisor is the number of the household's members in the register silc24_pr (all ages), so every household with a child is too high
